an.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now misty grey instead of red. Her face and pose: sly secret smile, one eye winking, one finger at her lips 'shh', the other hand hiding a small folded letter behind her wide sleeve, soft grey mist wisps and one small grey question mark. Clear readable action: the 'shh' finger and the hidden letter clearly visible, exactly two hands, arms kept inside the medallion. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
an.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed misty grey medallion as the reference. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. an.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion turns secretive: she leans forward over the gold rim, raises one finger to her lips 'shh', slips a small folded letter behind her wide sleeve with the other hand and winks, grey mist wisps drift, a small question mark appears; she comes out of the round frame toward the viewer. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, arms stay inside the picture, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
